permanent_fix_required: Extend tools/aria-adapters/test-gap-adapter.ts heuristic from adjacent-or-importing test signal to also scan e2e/tests/integration/**/*.spec.ts file CONTENTS for: (a) migration class name as substring (e.g. 'AuditLogImmutability' literal in test source), (b) SQL DDL signatures (CREATE TABLE / ALTER TABLE / CREATE INDEX matching migration content), (c) typeorm DataSource invocations targeting tables touched by the migration. Also: exclude *.spec.ts file extensions from migration_registry_missing_entry candidate list (the .spec.ts file 1781200000000-ConvertFarmOutboxToIdentity.spec.ts is a test, not a migration, but adapter currently flags it as unregistered migration). Add unit tests covering: (1) migration with adjacent test - no flag (existing behavior preserved), (2) migration with e2e integration test referencing class name - no flag (new behavior), (3) migration with no test signal anywhere - flagged (existing behavior preserved), (4) .spec.ts file with timestamp-prefixed name - excluded (new behavior).
root_cause_summary: test-gap-adapter heuristic was scoped to adjacent test files (same directory + matching name) and import-based detection (test files that import the migration class). This misses the dominant test pattern in this monorepo: e2e integration tests at e2e/tests/integration/**/*.spec.ts that test migration BEHAVIOR by querying the database state directly without importing the migration class. As a result, every e2e-tested migration generates a false-positive migration_without_test finding. Additionally, the adapter's migration file detection regex matches .spec.ts files when they happen to follow the timestamp-prefixed naming convention (1781200000000-ConvertFarmOutboxToIdentity.spec.ts is a regression test for the migration, not a migration itself). The architectural fix is to widen the heuristic to content-based test signal detection plus narrow the candidate list to exclude .spec.ts extensions.
